post.subject: [Zenless Zone Zero] | Methods for Obtaining Agent and W-Engine Upgrade Materials - VR Gameplay Introduction
post.content:
Foreword

During everyone's experience in Zenless Zone Zero, the VR Testing Machine is an essential facility in the game in which the players can obtain materials for character leveling and advancement, skill enhancement items, and more. Let's take a look at the various stages and functions in the VR Testing Machine.


Combat Simulation

Location

At the HIA Club, after talking to the character on the left, you can enter the Combat Simulation.

In the Combat Simulation, there are stages including Basic Material, Agent Promotion, Agent Skill, W-Engine Modification and Custom. In the Basic Material stage, you can farm Investigator Logs, W-Engine upgrade materials, Dennies and Drive Disc upgrade materials. In the Agent Promotion stage, you can obtain certification seals for various core roles, which are used for character promotion. In the Agent Skill stage, you can farm chips of various attributes, which are used to enhance character skills. The W-Engine Modification stage includes W-Engine upgrade materials for each core role. Players simply need to select the monster cards corresponding to the desired materials, formulate a plan, and then spend stamina to obtain the materials through battles.



Players can also use the Custom template to set the materials they want to farm, achieving their goals in one go.


Routine Cleanup

Location

After talking to the character on the right inside Scott Outpost, you can enter the Routine Cleanup.

In Routine Cleanup, players can select the stage based on the type of Drive Disc they want. Completing the challenge gives them a chance to obtain the corresponding Drive Discs, Plating Agents, and Dennies. Equipping Drive Disc can significantly enhance an Agent’s combat abilities, while Plating Agent can be used to enhance the Drive Discs.


Expert Challenge

Location

At the HIA Club, after talking to the character on the right, you can enter the Expert Challenge.

In the Expert Challenge, players will confront enemies they have battled before. Upon victory, they can obtain Inter-Knot Credits, Dennies, Master Copies and corresponding Higher Dimensional Data materials. Higher Dimensional Data can be used to upgrade an Agent's core skill level, while Master Copies can be used for tuning at the Music Store to obtain the desired Drive Discs.


Notorious Hunt

Location

After talking to the character on the left inside Scott Outpost, you can enter the Notorious Hunt.

In Notorious Hunt, players will face off against former formidable foes. Defeating these enemies rewards players with Precious Relics, Investigation Merits, Plating Agents, and W-Engine Chips, among other rewards. Precious Relics can be used to upgrade high-level Agent Core Skills. Investigation Merits can be exchanged for valuable rewards in the association's supply store, and W-Engine Chips can be used to purchase some 3-star and 4-star W-Engines at the Gadget Store. Different enemies provide different high-level Core Skill upgrade materials. Proxies need to choose which formidable foes to challenge based on their own needs. You can earn Notorious Hunt rewards up to 3 times. Additionally, weekly challenges reset every week. Completing these challenges can earn you extra rewards.

Once players unlock the above gameplay modes, they can open the Compendium via the third button in the upper right corner and select the stages they want to farm in the Training and Challenges sections. As the Inter-Knot Level and Inter-Knot Reputation increase, higher difficulty stages will become available, offering more abundant resources.

Conclusion

If you like this guide, don't forget to save it and give it a thumbs-up! I'll bring you more detailed guides in the future. Stay tuned for more! ❤
